NFL expands global reach with exhibition games in Australia

The National Football League (NFL) has expanded its international presence by holding exhibition games in Melbourne, Australia, at the Melbourne Cricket Ground (MCG). This move is part of the league's broader strategy for global expansion. The games in Australia are seen as a significant step in the NFL's plan to increase its international fanbase and market reach. The league aims to "conquer" new territories and "gatecrash" established sports markets, as indicated by reports.
